description: This file defines the 'Curso' entity class, which maps to the 'curso' table in a database. It uses annotations for ORM mapping (Hibernate/JPA), Lombok for boilerplate code reduction, and includes fields representing course properties such as name, description, difficulty, URL, image URL, and an association with a 'Profesor' entity.
